close_reason: Added README Gotchas entry for CallerCtx clone-per-call cost + Arc<T> mitigation. The cost is one CallerCtx clone + two String clones per method call in the batch.
description:
crate-jmap-server/src/lib.rs:154 + lib.rs:255 — Dispatcher requires CallerCtx: Clone + Send + 'static, and the dispatch loop clones the caller value per method call (caller_clone = caller.clone() before each task::spawn). The Dispatcher rustdoc mentions this briefly ("CallerCtx is cloned for each method call in the batch"), but the README "Gotchas" section does not.

An integrator who passes a heavy CallerCtx (e.g. a struct embedding a session token, a permissions vector, a user profile, an opaque auth blob) pays the clone cost on every method call. For a 16-call batch, that is 16 deep clones per request, in addition to the unconditional method.clone() and call_id.clone() at lib.rs:256-257.

The right pattern (Arc<T>) is mentioned in the Dispatcher rustdoc but not in the README, where a kit consumer is more likely to look first.

Recommendation: add to README "Gotchas":
  - **CallerCtx is cloned per method call.** Dispatcher::dispatch performs one Clone of the CallerCtx value per method in the batch, plus two String clones for method name and call_id. Heavy CallerCtx values (auth profiles, permission vectors, session tokens) should be wrapped in Arc<T> so the per-call clone is a pointer bump rather than a deep copy.

Also worth surfacing in the workspace AGENTS.md identity-seam section, which discusses CallerCtx without mentioning its clone cost.
title: CallerCtx clone-per-call cost undocumented in README/gotchas
